A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''fighter''' was a member of the [[Partisans]] shortly after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Serving under [[Saw Gerrera]], the fighter was one of many rebels who refused to accept the Empire's rule and went into hiding in [[Onderon]]'s [[jungle]].<ref name="Aftermath" /> He was [[Death|killed]] when the Empire [[Mission to Onderon (Elite Squad)|sent]] an [[Elite Squad]] to attack a rebel camp in the hopes of killing Gerrera while attempting to start up an [[LAAT/le patrol gunship]].<ref name="Replacements" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This Onderonian fighter first appeared in "[[Aftermath (episode)|Aftermath]]," the first episode of the [[2021]] web-TV series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''.<ref name="Aftermath" /> He reappeared two episodes later in "[[Replacements]]." He was voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]], who also voiced [[Wilhuff Tarkin|Admiral Tarkin]] in the same episode, as well.<ref name="Replacements" />
